newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul sets 4th qtr o'seas equity-linked bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Seoul sets 4th qtr o'seas equity-linked bond issue.

text.p: South Korea will issue $1.06 billion worth of equity-linked bonds overseas in the fourth quarter, the Korea Securities Dealers Association said on Friday.
The association said the issue plan compared with $979.4 million a year earlier.
It said the fourth quarter issue would bring the total overseas issues of equity-linked bonds for whole of this year to $3.32 billion, against $2.31 billion in 1995.
The Korea Long-Term Credit Bank plans to issue $200 million in depositary receipts in the fourth quarter, and Cho Hung Bank was approved to issue $250 million.
